exposure: Children breastfed for more than 6 months
cohort: 150 children aged 1-12 years who underwent tonsillectomy at Alfayhaa Teaching Hospital between January 2017 and July 2018, compared to 300 controls attending the hospital for other reasons.
finding: Infants breastfed for more than 6 months were less likely to have a tonsillectomy during childhood.
